quarterly_data.signal: Macronix August 2026 unaudited consolidated net sales were NT$8.145 billion, up 5.4% from July (NT$7.725 billion) and up 218.5% from August 2025 (NT$2.557 billion). January-August 2026 cumulative net sales were NT$45.463 billion, up 149.1% from NT$18.248 billion a year earlier.
